preconditions.description: The numerator must be between 1 and 2000, inclusive.
The denominator must be between 1 and 2000, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The returned string must represent the decimal form of the fraction numerator/denominator.
If the numerator is divisible by the denominator, the returned string must be the integer part only.

postconditions.expression: if (numerator % denominator != 0): '(' in return_value and ')' in return_value
postconditions.description: If the fractional part is repeating, the repeating part must be enclosed in parentheses.
